args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production. The service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback was verified successful across all regions and the service is now running v2.3.0. v2.3.1 was never healthy in production and should not be redeployed until the regression is root-caused.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: Release history showed v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent version healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout verified.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: Service is now running v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident** **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the v2.3.1 health-check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and a note that v2.3.1 was never healthy in production and shouldn't be redeployed without root-causing the regression. On-call has been paged.
